# BSK public API documentation

Implementation baseline: bsk-qqbot main @ 75ec6037a5cd6f6e59bfde10bf8fb03a74c4d7a9 (2026-10-02).
Read code-backed contracts, not old changelog assertions.

- [Overview](./README.md)
- [Versions and migration](./docs/api/README.md)
- [Current v1-261001](./docs/api/v1-261001/README.md)
- [Legacy Chinese v1-260925](./docs/api/v1-260925/README.md)
- [Unmodified historical text](./docs/api/v1-260925/REFERENCE.md)
- [Permanent parameter IDs 1–24](./docs/api/parameter-registry.md)
- [Evidence and implementation gaps](./docs/api/verification.md)
- [Per-endpoint docs](./docs/api/v1-261001/endpoints/)
- [Client tools](./interceptor/README.md)

No version and /v1 use v1-261001; v1-260925 selects Chinese compatibility.
Unregistered date versions return 404 unknown_version. Bare older majors such as v0 are an undocumented parser compatibility branch.
Version headers appear on version-routed JSON, not raw proxies, early concurrency rejection or unknown-version errors.
Legacy contracts share current authentication, quotas and sources; they are not a separately frozen server.

Site data endpoints support GET/POST. Hypixel resource proxy is GET-only. Bugland supports GET/POST at /bjd/v2/*.
POST /api/hypixel discovery is free; GET /api/hypixel/v1 is an upstream /v2/v1 request, not discovery.

Hypixel: 12s/key, max 3 distinct keys, 30s upstream budget; fixed 300s successful nonempty HTTP200 cache, capacity512.
Default QQBOT_PROXY_RATE=600/min; /apikey rate proxy supports positive integer, 0 unlimited and off environment fallback.
Successful writeback settles full base plus size surcharge; upstream/writeback failures settle half base with no size fee.
X-Quota-Cost is usually the theoretical body-size tier, not an invoice.

Bancheck: UUID 0.7, name 1.0; local case-insensitive index only, no per-request Mojang resolution.
Unknown means known=false, banned=null, state=unknown, data_quality=no_record; no name/uuid/banned_at keys.
Not banned display does not guarantee a clean account; tracking data is not official real-time verification.
banned_at represents the primary source event, including unban events. Bancheck has no days-ago field; card ban_status does.

Bugland: bsk_bjd_ prefix, independent tokens/state/quota, default30/min, no cache, no half-price rule.
Shared process concurrency is distinct from each service's per-key quota.
Registered request IDs are permanent and append-only. Arbitrary upstream parameters have no locally assigned ID.
Parameter IDs are distinct from response state/source/code/id and card display IDs.
Some declared body aliases are ignored; see the registry's implementation discrepancy table.
Modern locale=en can still contain untranslated errors, region arrays and raw third-party strings.
